The BMV’s Driver’s Manual contains the latest information you will need to successfully pass an operator’s knowledge examination (written test) and obtain an Indiana driver’s license. The Driver’s Manual is also a great way for anyone to review updated traffic laws and regulations.

Please note: Printed manuals are updated a maximum of one time each year and could contain outdated information. The most up-to-date version of the Indiana Driver’s Manual is in electronic format and available for download below in several different languages.

passing_score.verbatim: On the actual knowledge examination, you must have 80% or higher correct on each component to pass the exam.

exam_facts.note: passing 80 percent from physical p68 (printed 63), Chapter 9 sample-question intro: the exam has two components (signs; traffic rules and laws) and 80% or higher is required on EACH component. The manual states NO question count (per component or total) and NO time limit anywhere (grep of all 84 pages) - both null, not imported from memory. Knowledge exam format (multiple-choice, computer-based; arrive 30 minutes before close; retake next business day) on physical p10 (printed 5). Printed page = physical - 5 for pages 6-77. Edition: the only edition line is the back cover p84 'Published July 2026'; the registrar accepts edition observations on physical page 1 only, and the front cover prints none, so liveness stays VERIFICATION_DEBT. Not mapped: covers, inside-cover branch map (p2), TOC (p4-5), Chapter 9 sample questions (p68-72), notes and back pages (p79-84).
